name: Forbidden Love
source:
[b]When faced with something you desire but cannot attain, should you accept your fate and let it go—or fight against destiny to make it yours?[/b]

As a child, the protagonist dreamed of becoming a comic artist. But faced with strong opposition from their parents and mounting obstacles, that dream was eventually abandoned. Instead, they became a teacher.

One day, in the midst of their teaching career, they meet Yejin Un, a student being forced into an unwanted path by her parents—just like the protagonist once was.
Moved by a desire to prevent Yejin from repeating their own mistakes, the protagonist decides to support her in entering an art contest.

As Yejin pushes forward toward her dream, she begins to rely on the protagonist more than she should. Caught between the boundaries of teacher and student, the protagonist struggles to support her without crossing a line.

In the process, Yejin becomes increasingly obsessed with the protagonist.

Can Yejin truly walk a different path from the one the protagonist was forced to take?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3988640/]Steam[/url]]
